summary: At segment 0 step 319, JavaScript retains the stoning condition after newman(), while C clears it. C polyself.c:newman calls make_stoned(0, ...) whenever Stoned is active; JavaScript polyself.js:newman records that call as an unported gap despite importing the existing potion.js make_stoned implementation. The stale status line is the first screen difference, and a subsequent extra rn2(2) before C's dosounds rn2(400) confirms that downstream processing has diverged. Replacing the gap with the existing call is the bounded repair.

source.branch: When the hero has an active Stoned timeout after regeneration into human form, newman() calls make_stoned(0, NULL, 0, NULL), which clears the timeout and delayed killer before newuhs(FALSE) and the new-form message.
